text:
maria_cs: Hey team — Peregrine's Dedicated pool goes live next Tue 09:00 PT. Need a quick sync on quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and the load-test window. I put a draft runbook here: https://redwood-docs.internal/peregrine/dedicated-runbook (WIP).
liam_se: Thanks — can we do a short call tomorrow 11:30 PT? I want to confirm their traffic mix (short chat bursts + batch embedding jobs).
natalie_sre: +1 for call. For SRE monitoring, we'll need: per-pool token/sec, queue depth, and OOM/retry counters. Suggest alert thresholds: 85% GPU util for 5m and qdepth > 200 for 2m.
jordan_eng: FYI the model fallback chain we've agreed for Peregrine: rwd-13b-quant -> rwd-13b-onnx -> rwd-7b-quant. We'll auto-fallback when 95th latency exceeds 1.5s. Need to coordinate rollbacks if quality drops.
liam_se: Load test note: we'll run two phases — steady-state 5k rps equivalent for 30m, then 10m shock bursts. I've uploaded the k6 script to the folder. Snippet:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m scripts/peregrine_chat_profile.js
```
devon_onboard: I'll run the customer enablement at Fri 15:00 PT — walkthrough of rate-limits, warmup docs, and failover expectations. Can someone from eng join for Q&A? @jordan_eng ?
jordan_eng: I can join Fri 15. Also want to capture any model-specific prompting guidance to avoid hallucination spikes under high concurrency.
ops-bot: Reservation confirmed: reserved-dedicated-pool-peregrine (8 x A100) from 2025-03-25 08:00 to 2025-04-01 08:00 UTC.
maria_cs: Great — Liam/Natalie: can you verify autoscale policy names and cooldowns? We usually run: min=2, target=6, max=12, scale-up-cooldown=60s, scale-down=300s.
liam_se: We'll start with those but recommend bumping scale-down to 600s for their bursty pattern. Otherwise we thrash during chat sessions.
natalie_sre: Agree on 600s. Also add a soft-cap throttle rule at 90% to give clients a backoff signal before hard rejects.
devon_onboard: Customer wants a shadow traffic test (mirror 10% of prod requests). Is that ok from privacy/billing?
maria_cs: Peregrine signed opt-in for shadowing in the contract. Billing = no-charge for shadowed tokens but we need to flag it in the console.
liam_se: For load test logistics — prefer Wed 02:00 PT for the steady-state, Thu 02:00 PT for the bomb/test-to-failure. Ops needs 48h notice to unblock other tenants.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 2025-03-26 01:00-03:00 UTC may affect regional routing.
jordan_eng: Can we also enable prefix KV caching for their chat flows? That should drop token cost ~25% on warm sessions. We need customer consent to cache prefixes (they agreed in the form).
maria_cs: Action items: 1) Liam: finalize k6 scripts + perf targets (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Natalie: add alerts/dashboards and set throttle rule (due before load test). 3) Devon: finalize enablement deck and confirm Friday details (due Thu lunchtime). 4) Jordan: enable KV cache + document fallback QoS (due before runbook freeze).
liam_se: I'll drop the k6 link in this thread once updated.
natalie_sre: I'll create a pager rotation for the test window and post escalation steps.
maria_cs: Awesome. If anyone sees a renewal risk flag (billing or SLA concerns) bring it up now — Peregrine is high-touch renewal in 6 months.
devon_onboard: Noted — will capture customer feedback during enablement and log any product asks.
maria_cs: Ok, meeting tomorrow 11:30 PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:
